sources.note: Main vendor website. Describes MDOfficeManager as EHR software company providing RCM, medical coding, EMR, practice management, and transcription services.
ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists GeeseMed EHR v7.1 certification details, relied-upon software (EMRDirect, Medispan), links to RWT plan and B-10 export documentation.
Product page describing GeeseMed EMR and MDOfficeManager PMS as integrated components. Details e-Rx, lab interface, patient portal, health information exchange, and practice management features.
GeeseMed product website. Describes EMR features including smart clinical apps, managed billing, patient engagement, telehealth, LTC integration with Point Click Care, and 22+ specialty support.
About page. GeeseMed created by physicians and IT professionals, based in Clarksville, Indiana. Cloud-based, supports 22+ specialties, designed with six sigma philosophy.
Describes medical transcription and clinical document management services. Dictation-to-document workflow, DRT, CDA documents, HL7 interfaces, 99.5% accuracy guarantee.
Managed billing services page. Fully integrated billing and EHR, claims processing, dashboard analytics, compliance management, automated workflows.
EMR feature page. Smart clinical apps, template library with macros, five-click data policy, MIPS/ICD-10 compliance, cross-device accessibility.
Press release about ONC certification from Drummond Group. GeeseMed v7.0 initially certified Feb 2018. Describes cloud-based EMR for Meaningful Use compliance.
360Quadrants listing. Founded 1999, Indiana, revenue below $10M, ranked 97th in EHR market. No user reviews available. Lists patient portal, secure messaging, lab integration as key features.

FindEMR listing. Describes MDOfficeManager as virtual managerial software for hospitals. Lists e-prescribing, scheduling, patient portal, claims management, telemedicine. Pricing noted as $250/year. Zero user reviews.
MDOfficeManager managed billing page. Integrated billing and EMR, clean claim optimization, dashboard analytics, cloud-based compliance management.
